[Lihat Selengkapnya Episode 103 II] Sinar Matahari Dipandang sebagai Keamanan - Peringatan Hormuz

Krisis energi dipicu oleh blokade Selat Hormuz setelah invasi AS ke Iran. IEA (Badan Energi Internasional), IMF, dan PBB semuanya sepakat mengidentifikasi energi terbarukan sebagai solusinya. Energi terbarukan dibahas dalam bahasa keamanan energi, bukan iklim.

Namun, Korea termasuk yang terendah di antara negara-negara OECD. Negara ini tertinggal dari Jepang dan telah disalip oleh Taiwan. Kekurangan jaringan listrik, peraturan yang tidak konsisten, dan kepentingan kota yang kompleks menghambat kemajuan. Industri yang tumbuh di lingkungan rumah kaca belum menjadi kuat, dan sistem untuk mengendalikan 200.000 pembangkit listrik secara efektif masih jauh dari kenyataan.

Dari mana kita harus mulai mengatasi hal ini? Pada dasarnya, kita harus menyelesaikan masalah jaringan listrik antar negara (grid-to-grid), yang merupakan hambatan terbesar bagi perluasan tenaga surya, tetapi ada langkah-langkah yang lebih mendesak yang dapat kita ambil. Kita harus berupaya untuk menyelesaikan sendiri kebutuhan listrik yang saat ini dipinjam oleh wilayah metropolitan Seoul dari daerah regional. Bahkan jika kita hanya memanfaatkan seperlima dari ruang atap di wilayah ibu kota, kita dapat mengganti 40% listrik yang saat ini dipinjam dari daerah regional. Kita juga harus melakukan upaya yang lebih besar untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang terkait dengan berbagai peraturan dan kurangnya insentif.

Selain Tiongkok, Korea Selatan adalah satu-satunya negara yang memiliki seluruh spektrum industri hijau, dari sel surya hingga baterai. Karena kita memiliki teknologi, modal, dan infrastruktur, kita harus menunjukkan kemauan politik, seperti Denmark, yang tidak mengubah kebijakannya selama 50 tahun setelah guncangan minyak tahun 1970-an.

en-US.title: The Park Golf Craze... The Shadow of the 'Green Grass' / No Sunshine - Hormuz's Warning | See Mor...
en-US.description:
[See More Episode 103 |] The Park Golf Craze… The Shadow of the ‘Green Grass’

Park golf is a sport that can be enjoyed relatively simply with just one club and one ball. In South Korea, which has entered a super-aged society, it is gaining popularity like a craze, particularly among the elderly. One park golf course in Seoul sees a month's worth of reservations filled up in just a few minutes. As of the end of 2025, the number of park golf members is projected to reach approximately 229,000, a fivefold increase from about 45,000 in 2020 over five years. Furthermore, the number of park golf courses nationwide is expected to more than double from 226 in 2019 to 552 by the end of 2025. This is because it is cheaper than regular golf and allows people to maintain their health without the hassle of playing close to home. However, wildlife habitats are being damaged by park golf courses built along rivers without permission, and cases of illegal construction on farmland and forests are also on the rise. We examine the pros and cons of park golf courses, which are highly popular among the elderly.

[See More Episode 103 II] Sunlight is Seen as Security - The Warning of Hormuz

An energy crisis was triggered by the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz following the U.S. invasion of Iran. The IEA (International Energy Agency), IMF, and UN have all unanimously identified renewable energy as the solution. Renewable energy is being discussed in the language of energy security rather than climate.

However, Korea ranks among the lowest in the OECD. It has fallen behind Japan and been overtaken by Taiwan. Grid shortages, inconsistent regulations, and the complex interests of cities are hindering progress. Industries nurtured in a greenhouse have not become strong, and a system to effectively control 200,000 power plants is still a long way off.

Where should we begin to address this? Fundamentally, we must resolve the grid-to-grid issue, which is the biggest obstacle to the expansion of solar power, but there are more immediate measures we can take. We must strive to resolve the electricity that the Seoul metropolitan area currently borrows from regional areas on our own. Even if we utilize just one-fifth of the rooftop space in the capital area, we could replace 40% of the electricity currently borrowed from regional areas. We must also make greater efforts to resolve issues related to various regulations and a lack of incentives.

Excluding China, South Korea is the only country that possesses the entire spectrum of green industries, from solar cells to batteries. Since we possess the technology, capital, and infrastructure, we must demonstrate political will, much like Denmark, which did not change its policies for 50 years following the 1970s oil shock.

Reporting: Seo Young-min

snippet.title: 조선족 - 경계에 서다 [예고] | 창 547회 (KBS 26.5.12.)
snippet.description:
"조선족이라서 중국인도 아닌 것 같고 한국인도 아닌 것 같고"
     
1992년 한중 수교를 기점으로 중국 동포들이 본격적으로 한국에 들어오기 시작했다.

30여 년이 흘러, 당시 3만 5천 명이던 중국 동포의 수는 이제 67만 명에 이른다. 

국내 체류 이주민 중 가장 큰 집단이 됐지만, 이들에 대한 시선은 여전히 엇갈린다.

[시사기획 창]은 중국 동포가 한국 노동시장에서 해온 역할을 분석하고, 이들을 둘러싼 비자 정책과 사회적 인식의 배경을 짚었다.


■ 한국이 필요로 했던 사람들

1992년 한중 수교 이후 중국 동포들은 한국 노동 시장의 빈자리를 채워왔다.

현재 건설 현장 외국인 노동자의 80% 이상, 수도권 요양병원 간병인의 80~90%는 중국 동포인 것으로 추정된다.

전문가는 "동포가 빠져나가면 건설 현장의 숙련 시장이 어려워지고, 간병 시장은 금방 무너질 것"이라고 말한다.


■ 동포? 외국인 노동자? 혹은 '짱 X'? 


중국 동포의 비자는 오랫동안 단순 노무만 가능한 방문취업(H-2) 비자와 재외동포(F-4) 비자로 나뉘어 있었다.

처음부터 재외동포 비자를 받을 수 있었던 미국·일본 국적 동포들과는 다른 점이다.

20년 가까이 나뉘어져 있던 비자는 올해 초 하나로 통합됐다.

중국 동포를 바라보는 사회적 인식도 확인했다. 

[시사기획 창]이 전국 성인 1,036명을 대상으로 설문 조사한 결과, 미국·일본·고려인 등 다른 국적 동포 집단에 대한 호감도는 30% 수준이었지만, 중국 동포에 대한 호감도는 8.4%에 그쳤다.

지난해에는 혐오 집회 세력의 표적이 되기도 했다. 

서울 명동에서 시작된 혐중 집회는 대림동 등 동포들의 주거 지역까지 확산됐고, 시위대는 초·중·고교가 있는 거리까지 행진했다. 학생들까지 혐오 발언에 노출된 것이다.  

온라인에만 있던 혐오가 표면으로 표출된 위험 신호를 진단한다.
     

■ 연변의 청년들, 새로운 선택

     
취재진은 중국 동포들의 고향인 연변 조선족자치주에서 새로운 세대의 동포들을 만났다. 

K-팝과 한국 드라마에 익숙한 연변의 청년들에게 한국은 여전히 매력적인 선택지이지만, 더 이상 유일한 길은 아니다.

부모 세대가 건설 현장과 식당, 요양 병원 등에서 일했다면, 이들은 사무직과 기술직을 원하고, 상해와 베이징 등 중국 대도시로도 눈을 돌린다.


■ 경계에 선 사람들, 한국 사회가 답할 차례


저출산·고령화로 생산가능 인구가 줄어드는 한국에서, 67만 중국 동포는 더 이상 외면할 수 없는 존재가 됐다.

전문가들은 같은 언어와 문화를 공유하는 동포의 정착과 통합이 어렵다면, 비 동포 외국인과의 공존은 더욱 어려울 것이라고 지적한다.

중국 동포와의 공존은 다문화 사회로 나아가는 한국이 더 이상 미룰 수 없는 과제다.

전문가는 "동포가 빠져나가면 건설 현장의 숙련 시장이 어려워지고, 간병 시장은 금방 무너질 것"이라고 말한다.


■ 동포? 외국인 노동자? 혹은 '짱 X'? 


중국 동포의 비자는 오랫동안 단순 노무만 가능한 방문취업(H-2) 비자와 재외동포(F-4) 비자로 나뉘어 있었다.

처음부터 재외동포 비자를 받을 수 있었던 미국·일본 국적 동포들과는 다른 점이다.

20년 가까이 나뉘어져 있던 비자는 올해 초 하나로 통합됐다.

중국 동포를 바라보는 사회적 인식도 확인했다. 

[시사기획 창]이 전국 성인 1,036명을 대상으로 설문 조사한 결과, 미국·일본·고려인 등 다른 국적 동포 집단에 대한 호감도는 30% 수준이었지만, 중국 동포에 대한 호감도는 8.4%에 그쳤다.

지난해에는 혐오 집회 세력의 표적이 되기도 했다. 

서울 명동에서 시작된 혐중 집회는 대림동 등 동포들의 주거 지역까지 확산됐고, 시위대는 초·중·고교가 있는 거리까지 행진했다. 학생들까지 혐오 발언에 노출된 것이다.  

온라인에만 있던 혐오가 표면으로 표출된 위험 신호를 진단한다.
     

■ 연변의 청년들, 새로운 선택

     
취재진은 중국 동포들의 고향인 연변 조선족자치주에서 새로운 세대의 동포들을 만났다. 

K-팝과 한국 드라마에 익숙한 연변의 청년들에게 한국은 여전히 매력적인 선택지이지만, 더 이상 유일한 길은 아니다.

부모 세대가 건설 현장과 식당, 요양 병원 등에서 일했다면, 이들은 사무직과 기술직을 원하고, 상해와 베이징 등 중국 대도시로도 눈을 돌린다.


■ 경계에 선 사람들, 한국 사회가 답할 차례


저출산·고령화로 생산가능 인구가 줄어드는 한국에서, 67만 중국 동포는 더 이상 외면할 수 없는 존재가 됐다.

전문가들은 같은 언어와 문화를 공유하는 동포의 정착과 통합이 어렵다면, 비 동포 외국인과의 공존은 더욱 어려울 것이라고 지적한다.

중국 동포와의 공존은 다문화 사회로 나아가는 한국이 더 이상 미룰 수 없는 과제다.

en-US.title: Korean Chinese - Standing on the Border [Preview] | Window Episode 547 (KBS May 12, 2026)
en-US.description:
"Because they are ethnic Koreans from China, they don't seem like Chinese, nor do they seem like Koreans."

With the establishment of diplomatic relations between South Korea and China in 1992, ethnic Koreans from China began entering Korea in earnest.

Over 30 years have passed, and the number of ethnic Koreans from China, which stood at 35,000 at the time, has now reached 670,000.

Although they have become the largest group among migrants residing in the country, views regarding them remain divided.

[Current Affairs Planning Window] analyzed the role ethnic Koreans from China have played in the Korean labor market and examined the background of visa policies and social perceptions surrounding them.

■ The People Korea Needed

Since the establishment of diplomatic relations between South Korea and China in 1992, ethnic Koreans from China have filled the void in the Korean labor market.

It is estimated that currently, ethnic Koreans from China account for over 80% of foreign workers at construction sites and 80–90% of caregivers at nursing hospitals in the Seoul metropolitan area.

An expert states, "If these ethnic Koreans leave, the skilled labor market at construction sites will suffer, and the caregiving market will collapse quickly."

■ Compatriots? Foreign Workers? Or 'Chinks'?

For a long time, visas for ethnic Koreans from China were divided into the Visiting Employment (H-2) visa, which allows only simple labor, and the Overseas Korean (F-4) visa.

This is different from ethnic Koreans with U.S. and Japanese citizenship who were eligible for the Overseas Korean visa from the beginning.

The visas, which had been separated for nearly 20 years, were integrated into a single system early this year.

The social perception of ethnic Koreans from China was also confirmed.

According to a survey of 1,036 adults nationwide conducted by [Sisa Gijeok Chang], favorability ratings for other ethnic Korean groups with different nationalities—such as Americans, Japanese, and Koryo-in—were around 30%, while favorability ratings for ethnic Koreans from China stood at only 8.4%.

Last year, they also became targets of hate rallies.

Anti-China rallies that began in Myeongdong, Seoul, spread to residential areas for ethnic Koreans such as Daerim-dong, and protesters marched to streets lined with elementary, middle, and high schools. Even students have been exposed to hate speech.

We diagnose the danger signal that hatred, previously confined to the online sphere, has surfaced.

■ Youths of Yanbian, A New Choice

The reporting team met with a new generation of compatriots in the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, the hometown of many ethnic Koreans in China.

For the youth of Yanbian, who are familiar with K-pop and Korean dramas, Korea remains an attractive option, but it is no longer the only path.

While their parents' generation worked in construction sites, restaurants, and nursing homes, this generation desires office and technical jobs and is turning their attention to major Chinese cities such as Shanghai and Beijing.

■ People on the Border, It Is Korean Society's Turn to Answer

In Korea, where the working-age population is shrinking due to low birth rates and an aging population, the 670,000 ethnic Koreans in China have become a presence that can no longer be ignored.

Experts point out that if the settlement and integration of compatriots who share the same language and culture remain difficult, coexistence with non-compatriot foreigners will be even more challenging. Coexistence with ethnic Koreans in China is a task that Korea, moving toward a multicultural society, can no longer postpone.

id.title: Korea-Tiongkok - Berdiri di Perbatasan [Cuplikan] | Window Episode 547 (KBS 12 Mei 2026)
id.description:
"Karena mereka adalah etnis Korea dari Tiongkok, mereka tidak tampak seperti orang Tiongkok, dan juga tidak tampak seperti orang Korea."

Dengan terjalinnya hubungan diplomatik antara Korea Selatan dan Tiongkok pada tahun 1992, etnis Korea dari Tiongkok mulai memasuki Korea secara besar-besaran.

Lebih dari 30 tahun telah berlalu, dan jumlah etnis Korea dari Tiongkok, yang saat itu berjumlah 35.000, kini telah mencapai 670.000.

Meskipun mereka telah menjadi kelompok terbesar di antara para migran yang tinggal di negara ini, pandangan mengenai mereka tetap terbagi.

[Jendela Perencanaan Urusan Saat Ini] menganalisis peran yang dimainkan etnis Korea dari Tiongkok dalam pasar tenaga kerja Korea dan meneliti latar belakang kebijakan visa dan persepsi sosial seputar mereka.

■ Orang-orang yang Dibutuhkan Korea

Sejak terjalinnya hubungan diplomatik antara Korea Selatan dan Tiongkok pada tahun 1992, etnis Korea dari Tiongkok telah mengisi kekosongan di pasar tenaga kerja Korea.

Diperkirakan saat ini, etnis Korea dari Tiongkok mencakup lebih dari 80% pekerja asing di lokasi konstruksi dan 80–90% pengasuh di rumah sakit perawatan lansia di wilayah metropolitan Seoul.

Seorang ahli menyatakan, "Jika etnis Korea ini pergi, pasar tenaga kerja terampil di lokasi konstruksi akan menderita, dan pasar pengasuhan akan runtuh dengan cepat."

■ Rekan sebangsa? Pekerja asing? Atau 'orang Tiongkok'?

Selama ini, visa untuk etnis Korea dari Tiongkok terbagi menjadi visa Kerja Kunjungan (H-2), yang hanya mengizinkan pekerjaan sederhana, dan visa Warga Korea Luar Negeri (F-4).

Hal ini berbeda dengan etnis Korea yang memiliki kewarganegaraan AS dan Jepang yang sejak awal memenuhi syarat untuk visa Warga Korea Luar Negeri.

Visa-visa tersebut, yang telah terpisah selama hampir 20 tahun, diintegrasikan ke dalam satu sistem pada awal tahun ini.

Persepsi sosial terhadap etnis Korea dari Tiongkok juga terkonfirmasi.

Menurut survei terhadap 1.036 orang dewasa di seluruh negeri yang dilakukan oleh [Sisa Gijeok Chang], peringkat kesukaan terhadap kelompok etnis Korea lainnya dengan kewarganegaraan berbeda—seperti Amerika, Jepang, dan Korea—berkisar sekitar 30%, sementara peringkat kesukaan terhadap etnis Korea dari Tiongkok hanya 8,4%.

Tahun lalu, mereka juga menjadi sasaran demonstrasi kebencian.

Demonstrasi anti-Tiongkok yang dimulai di Myeongdong, Seoul, menyebar ke daerah pemukiman etnis Korea seperti Daerim-dong, dan para pengunjuk rasa berbaris ke jalan-jalan yang dipenuhi sekolah dasar, menengah, dan atas. Bahkan siswa pun terpapar ujaran kebencian.

Kami mendiagnosis sinyal bahaya bahwa kebencian, yang sebelumnya terbatas pada ranah daring, telah muncul ke permukaan.

■ Pemuda Yanbian, Pilihan Baru

Tim pelaporan bertemu dengan generasi baru warga Korea di Prefektur Otonomi Korea Yanbian, kampung halaman banyak etnis Korea di Tiongkok.

Bagi kaum muda Yanbian, yang akrab dengan K-pop dan drama Korea, Korea tetap menjadi pilihan yang menarik, tetapi bukan lagi satu-satunya jalan.

Sementara generasi orang tua mereka bekerja di lokasi konstruksi, restoran, dan panti jompo, generasi ini menginginkan pekerjaan kantor dan teknis dan mengalihkan perhatian mereka ke kota-kota besar Tiongkok seperti Shanghai dan Beijing.

■ Orang-orang di Perbatasan, Kini Giliran Masyarakat Korea untuk Menjawab

Di Korea, di mana populasi usia kerja menyusut karena angka kelahiran rendah dan populasi yang menua, 670.000 etnis Korea di Tiongkok telah menjadi kehadiran yang tidak dapat lagi diabaikan.

Para ahli menunjukkan bahwa jika pemukiman dan integrasi sesama warga negara yang memiliki bahasa dan budaya yang sama tetap sulit, hidup berdampingan dengan warga negara asing non-Korea akan menjadi lebih menantang. Hidup berdampingan dengan etnis Korea di Tiongkok adalah tugas yang tidak dapat lagi ditunda oleh Korea, yang sedang menuju masyarakat multikultural.

snippet.title: '성차별이자 인종차별', 미군 위안부 '성병관리소'
snippet.description:
[더 보다 102회] 미군 위안부의 마지막 바람

정부가 과거 기지촌 여성들의 인권을 침해한 데 대해 공식 사과했다. 주한미군의 사기 진작을 위해 정부가 기지촌을 조성하고 성매매를 조장했다고 대법원이 판결한 지 4년 만이다. 국가 책임을 밝혀낸 미군 위안부들은 이제 주한미군을 상대로 생애 마지막 소송에 나섰다. 이들은 미군이 성매매 장소를 제공하고 기지촌 여성들의 명단과 사진을 직접 관리했을 뿐만 아니라, 강압적인 성병 통제로 인권을 유린했다고 증언한다. 이 같은 증언을 뒷받침하는 한미 양측의 문서가 잇따라 확인되는 가운데, 이달 말 역사적인 첫 재판이 열릴 예정이다. 그러나 정작 인권 침해가 벌어졌던 역사적 현장은 철거 위기에 놓여 있고, 아픈 역사를 기록하려는 시도 또한 순탄치 않다. 냉전과 분단, 권위주의 시대에 희생된 미군 위안부들의 목소리를 통해, 국가폭력의 기억을 외면해온 한국 사회의 현재를 짚어본다.

id.title: 'Seksism dan rasisme', 'wanita penghibur' militer AS, 'pusat pengendalian penyakit menular seksual'
id.description:
[The More] Episode 102: Permintaan Terakhir Para "Wanita Penghibur" Militer AS

Pemerintah telah mengeluarkan permintaan maaf resmi atas pelanggaran hak asasi manusia perempuan di kota-kota bekas pangkalan militer. Hal ini terjadi empat tahun setelah Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahwa pemerintah mendirikan kota-kota ini dan mempromosikan prostitusi untuk meningkatkan moral Pasukan AS di Korea (USFK). Setelah mengungkap tanggung jawab negara, para mantan wanita penghibur kini telah meluncurkan gugatan terakhir mereka terhadap USFK. Mereka bersaksi bahwa militer AS tidak hanya menyediakan lokasi untuk prostitusi dan secara langsung mengelola daftar dan foto para perempuan tersebut, tetapi juga melanggar hak asasi manusia mereka melalui kontrol paksa atas penyakit menular seksual. Karena dokumen dari AS dan Korea Selatan yang mendukung kesaksian ini dikonfirmasi satu demi satu, persidangan pertama yang bersejarah dijadwalkan akan diadakan pada akhir bulan ini. Namun, situs-situs bersejarah tempat pelanggaran hak asasi manusia ini benar-benar terjadi menghadapi ancaman pembongkaran, dan upaya untuk mendokumentasikan sejarah yang menyakitkan ini tidak berjalan lancar. Melalui suara para mantan wanita penghibur, yang menjadi korban Perang Dingin, perpecahan, dan era otoriter, kami meneliti keadaan masyarakat Korea saat ini, yang telah menutup mata terhadap ingatan akan kekerasan negara. #USMilitaryComfortWomen #MilitaryBaseTownWomen #USFK #StateViolence #MilitaryBaseTownWomenHumanRightsMovement #Militarism #Women'sRights #STDControlCenter

en-US.title: 'Sexism and racism', US military 'comfort women' 'STD control center'
en-US.description:
[The More] Episode 102: The Last Wish of the US Military "Comfort Women"

The government has issued an official apology for violating the human rights of women in former military base towns. This comes four years after the Supreme Court ruled that the government established these towns and promoted prostitution to boost the morale of US Forces Korea (USFK). Having uncovered state responsibility, the former comfort women have now launched their final lawsuit against the USFK. They testify that the US military not only provided locations for prostitution and directly managed the lists and photos of the women, but also violated their human rights through coercive control over sexually transmitted diseases. As documents from both the US and South Korea supporting these testimonies are being confirmed one after another, the historic first trial is scheduled to be held at the end of this month. However, the historical sites where these human rights violations actually occurred are facing the threat of demolition, and attempts to document this painful history are not proceeding smoothly. Through the voices of the former comfort women, who were victims of the Cold War, division, and authoritarian era, we examine the current state of Korean society, which has turned a blind eye to the memory of state violence. #USMilitaryComfortWomen #MilitaryBaseTownWomen #USFK #StateViolence #MilitaryBaseTownWomenHumanRightsMovement #Militarism #Women'sRights #STDControlCenter

ko.description:
[더 보다 102회] 미군 위안부의 마지막 바람

정부가 과거 기지촌 여성들의 인권을 침해한 데 대해 공식 사과했다. 주한미군의 사기 진작을 위해 정부가 기지촌을 조성하고 성매매를 조장했다고 대법원이 판결한 지 4년 만이다. 국가 책임을 밝혀낸 미군 위안부들은 이제 주한미군을 상대로 생애 마지막 소송에 나섰다. 이들은 미군이 성매매 장소를 제공하고 기지촌 여성들의 명단과 사진을 직접 관리했을 뿐만 아니라, 강압적인 성병 통제로 인권을 유린했다고 증언한다. 이 같은 증언을 뒷받침하는 한미 양측의 문서가 잇따라 확인되는 가운데, 이달 말 역사적인 첫 재판이 열릴 예정이다. 그러나 정작 인권 침해가 벌어졌던 역사적 현장은 철거 위기에 놓여 있고, 아픈 역사를 기록하려는 시도 또한 순탄치 않다. 냉전과 분단, 권위주의 시대에 희생된 미군 위안부들의 목소리를 통해, 국가폭력의 기억을 외면해온 한국 사회의 현재를 짚어본다. 

#미군위안부 #기지촌여성 #주한미군 #국가폭력 #기지촌여성인권운동 #군사주의 #여성인권 #성병관리소

snippet.title: 새로 바뀐 '의료분쟁조정법', 벼랑 끝 의료 현장 살릴까
snippet.description:
[더 보다 102회 I] 가벼워진 책임, 무거워진 진실

병을 고치려 찾은 병원에서 사랑하는 가족을 잃었다. 왜 죽었는지 진실이라도 알고 싶지만, 정보의 비대칭과 무거운 입증 책임 앞에서 유족은 한없이 작아진다.
의료계는 '사법 리스크'가 필수 의료를 붕괴시키고 있다고 호소한다. 벼랑 끝에 몰린 필수 의료를 살리기 위해 최근 국회 본회의를 통과한 '의료분쟁조정법' 개정안. 중과실이 없고 충분한 배상을 했다면 의료진의 형사 기소를 제한하는 특례 조항 등이 담겼다.
생명을 살리는 의료진의 짐을 덜어주는 것과 억울한 의료사고 피해자를 지켜주는 것. 어느 한쪽도 포기할 수 없는 가치 앞에서 '의료분쟁조정법' 개정안에 대한 찬반 논란은 여전히 팽팽하다. 법안 시행까지 남은 시간은 1년. 우리 사회는 어떤 해답을 내놓아야 할까.

id.title: Akankah 'Undang-Undang Mediasi Sengketa Medis' yang baru direvisi menyelamatkan bidang kedokteran...
id.description:
[Lihat Selengkapnya Episode 102 | Tanggung Jawab Lebih Ringan, Kebenaran Lebih Berat]

Seorang anggota keluarga tercinta meninggal di rumah sakit yang dikunjungi untuk mengobati penyakitnya. Meskipun mereka sangat ingin mengetahui kebenaran tentang penyebab kematian pasien, keluarga yang berduka merasa sangat kecil di hadapan ketidakseimbangan informasi dan beban pembuktian yang berat.

Komunitas medis menyatakan bahwa "risiko hukum" menghancurkan layanan medis penting. Untuk menyelamatkan perawatan medis penting yang terancam punah, amandemen terhadap "Undang-Undang Mediasi Sengketa Medis," yang baru-baru ini disahkan dalam sidang pleno Majelis Nasional, mencakup ketentuan khusus yang membatasi penuntutan pidana terhadap staf medis jika tidak ada kelalaian berat dan kompensasi yang cukup telah diberikan.

Meringankan beban para profesional medis penyelamat nyawa versus melindungi korban kecelakaan medis yang tidak adil—dihadapkan dengan nilai-nilai yang tidak dapat ditinggalkan, perdebatan tentang amandemen terhadap "Undang-Undang Mediasi Sengketa Medis" tetap sengit. Dengan satu tahun tersisa hingga RUU tersebut berlaku, solusi apa yang harus ditawarkan masyarakat kita?

en-US.title: Will the newly revised 'Medical Dispute Mediation Act' save the medical field on the brink?
en-US.description:
[See More Episode 102 | Lighter Responsibility, Heavyer Truth]

A beloved family member was lost at a hospital visited to cure an illness. Although they long to know the truth about why the patient died, the bereaved family feels infinitely small in the face of information asymmetry and the heavy burden of proof.

The medical community pleads that "legal risks" are destroying essential medical services. To save essential medical care pushed to the brink, the amendment to the "Medical Dispute Mediation Act," which recently passed the National Assembly plenary session, includes special provisions that restrict the criminal prosecution of medical staff if there is no gross negligence and sufficient compensation has been provided.

Lightening the burden on life-saving medical professionals versus protecting victims of unjust medical accidents—faced with values ​​that cannot be abandoned, the debate over the amendment to the "Medical Dispute Mediation Act" remains fierce. With one year remaining until the bill goes into effect, what solution must our society offer?

**The Truth and the Truth** #Medical #MedicalAccident #MedicalDispute #Doctor #Patient #Hospital #MedicalDisputeMediationAct #MedicalLawsuit #EssentialMedicalServices #Surgery #UniversityHospital #KBS #TheBoda

채 1개와 공 1개로 비교적 간단히 즐길 수 있는 파크골프. 초고령사회로 들어선 우리나라에서 노년층을 중심으로 열풍과 같은 인기를 끌고 있다. 서울의 한 파크골프장은 한 달 치 예약이 단 몇 분 만에 끝날 정도다. 2025년 말 기준 파크골프 회원수는 22만 9천여 명으로 2020년 4만 5천여 명에서 5년 새 5배로 증가했다. 또한 전국 파크골프장 수도 2025년 말 기준 552개로 2019년 226개에서 배 이상 늘었다. 일반 골프에 비해 비용도 저렴한 데다, 집 가까이에서 부담없이 이용하며 건강을 다질 수 있기 때문이다. 하지만 하천 변에 허가 없이 조성된 파크골프장으로 야생돌물 서식지가 훼손되고, 농지와 임야에 불법 조성하는 사례도 늘고 있다.
 노년층이 열광하는 파크골프장의 명암을 짚어 본다.

 취재 : 오종우
 촬영: 조선기, 강우용, 최승구
 편집: 유지영
 그래픽: 장수현
 리서처:서유리
 조연출: 엄희주, 박재범

#파크골프 #파크골프장 #월드컵공원 #노을공원 #탄천 #안양천 #양양 남대천 #갑천 #파크골프학과 #체육시설업


[더 보다 103회 II] 햇빛이 안보다 - 호르무즈의 경고

미국의 이란 침공 이후 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄로 에너지 위기가 촉발됐다. IEA(국제에너지기구), IMF, UN 등은 일제히 재생에너지를 해법으로 지목한다. 기후가 아니라 에너지 안보의 언어에서 재생에너지가 다뤄지고 있다.

그런데 한국은 OECD 최하위권이다. 일본에 뒤처지고, 대만에도 역전당했다. 계통 부족, 일관성 없는 규제, 도시의 복잡한 이해관계가 속도를 막는다. 온실 속에서 키운 산업은 강해지지 않았고, 20만 개 발전소를 효과적으로 제어할 시스템도 아직 멀리 있다.

어디서부터 풀어야할까. 근본적으로는 태양광 확산 최대 장애물인 계통-망 문제를 해결해야 하지만, 당장의 할 수 있는 일은 더 있다. '수도권이 지방으로부터 빌려쓰는 전기를 스스로 해결하려 노력'해야 한다. 수도권 건물 옥상의 5분의 1만 써도 지금 지역으로부터 빌려 쓰는 전기의 40%를 대체할 수 있다. 각종 규제와 인센티브 부족의 문제도 해결하려고 더 노력해야 한다.

대한민국은 중국을 제외하면 태양전지부터 배터리까지 녹색산업 전 분야를 가진 나라는 유일한 나라다. 기술과 돈, 인프라가 모두 있으니 '1970년대 오일쇼크 이후 50년간 정책을 바꾸지 않은 덴마크'처럼 정치적 의지를 발휘해야 한다 .

  촬영: 강우용 조선기
  촬영기자 : 권순두
  편집: 김태형
  그래픽: 장수현
  리서처: 채희주
  조연출: 엄희주 박재범

id.title: [Pratinjau] Kegilaan Golf di Taman... Bayangan 'Rumput Hijau' / Tanpa Sinar Matahari - Peringatan...
id.description:
[Lihat Selengkapnya Episode 103 |] Kegilaan Golf Taman… Bayangan ‘Rumput Hijau’

Golf taman adalah olahraga yang dapat dinikmati dengan relatif mudah hanya dengan satu tongkat dan satu bola. Di Korea Selatan, yang telah memasuki masyarakat super-tua, olahraga ini semakin populer seperti sebuah kegilaan, terutama di kalangan lansia. Sebuah lapangan golf taman di Seoul melihat reservasi selama sebulan penuh terisi hanya dalam beberapa menit. Pada akhir tahun 2025, jumlah anggota golf taman diproyeksikan mencapai sekitar 229.000, peningkatan lima kali lipat dari sekitar 45.000 pada tahun 2020 selama lima tahun. Lebih lanjut, jumlah lapangan golf taman di seluruh negeri diperkirakan akan meningkat lebih dari dua kali lipat dari 226 pada tahun 2019 menjadi 552 pada akhir tahun 2025. Hal ini karena lebih murah daripada golf biasa dan memungkinkan orang untuk menjaga kesehatan mereka tanpa repot bermain di dekat rumah. Namun, habitat satwa liar dirusak oleh lapangan golf taman yang dibangun di sepanjang sungai tanpa izin, dan kasus pembangunan ilegal di lahan pertanian dan hutan juga meningkat. Kami meneliti pro dan kontra lapangan golf taman, yang sangat populer di kalangan lansia.

Pelaporan: Oh Jong-woo

Pengambilan Gambar: Cho Seon-gi, Kang Woo-yong, Choi Seung-gu

Penyuntingan: Yoo Ji-young

Grafis: Jang Su-hyun

[Lihat Selengkapnya Episode 103 II] Sinar Matahari Dipandang sebagai Keamanan - Peringatan Hormuz

Krisis energi dipicu oleh blokade Selat Hormuz setelah invasi AS ke Iran. IEA (Badan Energi Internasional), IMF, dan PBB semuanya sepakat mengidentifikasi energi terbarukan sebagai solusinya. Energi terbarukan dibahas dalam bahasa keamanan energi, bukan iklim.

Namun, Korea termasuk yang terendah di antara negara-negara OECD. Negara ini tertinggal dari Jepang dan telah disalip oleh Taiwan. Kekurangan jaringan listrik, peraturan yang tidak konsisten, dan kepentingan kota yang kompleks menghambat kemajuan. Industri yang tumbuh di lingkungan rumah kaca belum menjadi kuat, dan sistem untuk mengendalikan 200.000 pembangkit listrik secara efektif masih jauh dari kenyataan.

Dari mana kita harus mulai mengatasi hal ini? Pada dasarnya, kita harus menyelesaikan masalah jaringan listrik antar negara (grid-to-grid), yang merupakan hambatan terbesar bagi perluasan tenaga surya, tetapi ada langkah-langkah yang lebih mendesak yang dapat kita ambil. Kita harus berupaya untuk menyelesaikan sendiri kebutuhan listrik yang saat ini dipinjam oleh wilayah metropolitan Seoul dari daerah regional. Bahkan jika kita hanya memanfaatkan seperlima dari ruang atap di wilayah ibu kota, kita dapat mengganti 40% listrik yang saat ini dipinjam dari daerah regional. Kita juga harus melakukan upaya yang lebih besar untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang terkait dengan berbagai peraturan dan kurangnya insentif.

Selain Tiongkok, Korea Selatan adalah satu-satunya negara yang memiliki seluruh spektrum industri hijau, dari sel surya hingga baterai. Karena kita memiliki teknologi, modal, dan infrastruktur, kita harus menunjukkan kemauan politik, seperti Denmark, yang tidak mengubah kebijakannya selama 50 tahun setelah guncangan minyak tahun 1970-an.

[See More Episode 103 |] The Park Golf Craze… The Shadow of the ‘Green Grass’

Park golf is a sport that can be enjoyed relatively simply with just one club and one ball. In South Korea, which has entered a super-aged society, it is gaining popularity like a craze, particularly among the elderly. One park golf course in Seoul sees a month's worth of reservations filled up in just a few minutes. As of the end of 2025, the number of park golf members is projected to reach approximately 229,000, a fivefold increase from about 45,000 in 2020 over five years. Furthermore, the number of park golf courses nationwide is expected to more than double from 226 in 2019 to 552 by the end of 2025. This is because it is cheaper than regular golf and allows people to maintain their health without the hassle of playing close to home. However, wildlife habitats are being damaged by park golf courses built along rivers without permission, and cases of illegal construction on farmland and forests are also on the rise. We examine the pros and cons of park golf courses, which are highly popular among the elderly.

[See More Episode 103 II] Sunlight is Seen as Security - The Warning of Hormuz

An energy crisis was triggered by the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz following the U.S. invasion of Iran. The IEA (International Energy Agency), IMF, and UN have all unanimously identified renewable energy as the solution. Renewable energy is being discussed in the language of energy security rather than climate.

However, Korea ranks among the lowest in the OECD. It has fallen behind Japan and been overtaken by Taiwan. Grid shortages, inconsistent regulations, and the complex interests of cities are hindering progress. Industries nurtured in a greenhouse have not become strong, and a system to effectively control 200,000 power plants is still a long way off.

Where should we begin to address this? Fundamentally, we must resolve the grid-to-grid issue, which is the biggest obstacle to the expansion of solar power, but there are more immediate measures we can take. We must strive to resolve the electricity that the Seoul metropolitan area currently borrows from regional areas on our own. Even if we utilize just one-fifth of the rooftop space in the capital area, we could replace 40% of the electricity currently borrowed from regional areas. We must also make greater efforts to resolve issues related to various regulations and a lack of incentives.

Excluding China, South Korea is the only country that possesses the entire spectrum of green industries, from solar cells to batteries. Since we possess the technology, capital, and infrastructure, we must demonstrate political will, much like Denmark, which did not change its policies for 50 years following the 1970s oil shock.
